resources.string: Export everything to a ZIP file, or restore from one
The ZIP file contains all your secrets: API keys, OAuth tokens, and service credentials. Keep it private, do not share it, and delete it after you have imported it.
Providers and keys, chats, personas, skills, memory, workflows, task runs, and settings.
Not included: wireless-debugging pairing (re-pair after import), the accessibility service setting (turn it back on in Android Settings), the sandbox workspace, and file library attachments.
Save your chats and personal skills to one password-protected file.
Add chats from a backup file. Chats already on this phone are never replaced or deleted.
Backup saved: %1$d files. %2$d keys could not be decrypted and were left out.
Model API keys, memory and files saved to Downloads are not included.
Choose a password of at least 8 characters. You will need it to restore this backup and it cannot be recovered.
Enter the password you chose when you exported this backup.

This phone already has chats and providers. Importing will replace them.
Close Orbit and open it again to use the restored data. Then re-pair wireless debugging, turn the accessibility service back on in Android Settings, and delete the backup ZIP file.
Export first, before you uninstall anything: only this install can decrypt your data.
